description: Flood hazard and water management 2018 is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. - Surface area of the municipality subject to flood risk (10-year return period), river contracts, flood partnerships, SAGE, A(l)qua - Sources: SIG-GR / GIS-GR 2018; REEW 2017; Office International de l'Eau, Gest'eau 2015-2016; MDDI 2018; HPI-CIP 2015; IBH RLP 2018. Harmonization: IGEAT 2018;. Coverage: SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. The publisher named on the listing is SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. Its keywords include meteorology, environment, management, weather, flood, security. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
